name: use-undo
title: useUndoStack
description: useUndoStack: the undo block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs a block that returns undo tokens (`relations` or `audit`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/undo.
